claim: The commercial nature of a secondary work does not automatically preclude a finding of fair use if the use is sufficiently transformative.
evidence: The Court held that the commercial or nonprofit educational purpose of a work is only one element of its purpose and character.
excerpt: Holding The Court reversed the Sixth Circuit, finding that it had erred in giving dispositive weight to the commercial nature of 2 Live Crew’s parody and in applying an evidentiary presumption that the commercial nature of the parody rendered it unfair. The Court held that the commercial or nonprofit educational purpose of a work is only one element of its purpose and character.
